content.title: RBC Heritage 2026 prize money: Full payout from $20 million purse - Golf Channel
content.text: 0 seconds of 4 minutes, 57 secondsVolume 0% PGA Tour Highlights: 2026 RBC Heritage, Final round April 19, 2026 08:06 PM Watch the best shots and moments from the final round of the RBC Heritage at Harbour Town Golf Links in Hilton Head Island, South Carolina. Matt Fitzpatrick bogeyed the par-4 18th to force a playoff with Scottie Scheffler at the RBC Heritage, then beat him with a brilliant birdie on the same hole.Fitzpatrick failed to get up and down for par at the end of regulation, bringing on sudden death with the world’s No. 1. Fitzpatrick won the RBC in 2023 and Scheffler did so in ’24. On the first extra hole, the Englishman laced his approach shot through the wind to 13 feet, from where he made the victorious putt.Just as he did four years ago, Fitzpatrick collected $3.6 million from the $20 million signature-event purse.
